rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Any student-facing file carrying practitioner citations MUST include a 'Source verification — MUST DO before first cohort' maintainer-block section with per-source freshness stamps (11a grammar: `[checked:... result:... due:...]`).
rules_evaluated.evidence: getting-going.md carries two load-bearing practitioner citations (Cherny l.57/59, Klaassen l.127) but has no 'Source verification' section at all — confirmed by grep (`Source verification|checked:|due:|result:` returns zero matches) and by running `source-freshness.sh --target 2026-08-01` against this file, which reports 'No source-freshness stamps found.' This is a real, letter-of-the-rule gap, not a false positive. Mitigating context, not a reason to drop the finding: (a) the Cherny freshness question IS addressed, just via a differently-shaped maintainer note (l.79's dated 'Freshness-rule exception' prose) rather than the canonical `[checked:... due:...]` grammar; (b) the Klaassen/every.to URL carries a live, unexpired canonical stamp in a sibling AE101 file (learn-from-the-test.md:195, `checked:2026-05-25 result:OK due:2026-11-25`) — the citation is genuinely verified repo-wide, just not re-stamped in this file's own copy; (c) this is a repo-wide pattern, not unique to this file — grep across the training shows plan-mode-done-right.md, earn-the-trust.md, and prework.md (all of which name Cherny or comparable practitioners) carry no Source-verification block either, suggesting a de-facto convention that thin module-container files point at the reference doc (multi-session-git.md, which DOES carry an Attribution line) rather than duplicating the stamp. That convention isn't written into check_research_claims.md as a carve-out the way check_pedagogy.md §64 carves out pointers for delivery-mechanics blocks — so it reads as an undocumented gap across the training, not a decision. Not blocking: both URLs are alive, both labels are honest, and the underlying freshness question is answered elsewhere and not yet due — no student-facing content is wrong or unverifiable, only the audit-trail bookkeeping this file's own copy owes is missing.
